answers.core: SCREEN_UV is a very basic built-in for the fragment() function. Such a built-in for the light() function would also be very basic.
answers.workaround: As mentioned above, you can use something like `vec2 SCRN_UV = (VIEW.xy + FRAGCOORD.xy) / VIEWPORT_SIZE;` to make your own SCREEN_UV variable in the light() function (I don't know if this is correct even), though IMO it feels intuitive that there would just be a SCREEN_UV bulit-in.

title: Add the built-in SCREEN_UV to the spatial shader's light() function
